decisions: authorize the metabolic acid-load state (1): its meaning, source and clearance, and lactate's relation to it
decide PaCO2 (2): algebraic from production and W, or a state with its own time constant

design.direction_rule: Structural, no RR range: 1 reads RR's monotonicity in lactate and W > 0 (the only 'need' the core has); 2 the RR at the clearance baseline against the ventilatory part; 3 the clearance probe (same D, different tau_lactate); 4, 5, 7 need an effective-ventilation output, mechanical ventilation and CO2, absent; 6 the oxygen probe; 8 the R4 trajectories: no RR term reads haemostasis, and the RR change across the haemostasis minute is compared with the largest one-minute RR change of the same trajectory.

directions.1: greater ventilatory need must not reduce RR if mechanics permit
directions.2: resolving metabolic / acidaemic drive permits RR recovery
directions.3: lactate decline alone must not force RR down while ventilatory need remains
directions.4: high RR must not imply adequate W when mechanics or fatigue limit ventilation
directions.5: mechanical-ventilation semantics override the spontaneous frequency where appropriate
directions.6: oxygen therapy may improve oxygenation without correcting ventilation
directions.7: CO2 clearance follows effective ventilation rather than RR alone
directions.8: no instantaneous RR normalization merely from haemostasis

design.equation: derive(state) -> lactate L = max(min(floor, L_arrival), baseline + aux.lactate_excess); RR = respiratory_rate(state, anchors, profile, L). With M(x) = rr_metabolic_max x (1 - exp(-rr_per_lactate x max(0, x - lactate_drive_threshold) / rr_metabolic_max)): the arrival RR splits into an arrival metabolic share S = min(M(L0), max(0, RR0 - rr_ventilatory_floor)) and a ventilatory part (RR0 - S) x (1 + max(0, W)); the metabolic part is S + M(L) - M(L0) when M(L) >= M(L0), else S x M(L) / M(L0); RR = min(rr_max, max(0, 1 + min(0, W)) x (ventilatory + metabolic)); 0 without a pulse. L0 and RR0 are the authored arrival lactate and RR. The aux lactate excess follows dX = debt_to_lactate_gain x D - X / tau_lactate on the minute before's D.

design.identifiability_rule: Frozen. A quantity on a path classified BIOMARKER_PROXY, SEMANTIC_LEAK or NOT_CURRENTLY_MODELED is NOT_APPLICABLE (no candidate surface stands on it). The baseline is PARTIALLY_CONSTRAINED: the authored arrival RR fixes the sum of the ventilatory part and the arrival metabolic share, not the split. A bound is NON_IDENTIFIABLE when no reconstructed trajectory reaches it, POORLY_IDENTIFIED when some do.
design.missing_structure: Smallest missing physiology, in order: (1) a metabolic acid-load state (a base-deficit-like quantity with an explicit source tied to the delivery shortfall and an explicit clearance), from which acidaemia is read, so that metabolic acidosis drives ventilation causally and lactate stays a biomarker beside it; (2) a CO2 representation: PaCO2 from CO2 production (demand) against effective alveolar ventilation W, algebraic unless kinetics are needed; (3) W split into ventilatory drive (acidaemia, PaCO2, hypoxaemia, depressants) and effective ventilation (drive limited by mechanics / fatigue), with RR the observable of the drive; (4) respiratory-support semantics separating oxygenation (FiO2) from ventilatory support (NIV, controlled ventilation) that sets W or the rate. (1) and (2) are the first step; each needs faculty authorization before any number.
design.policy: Shadow only. The core is unchanged; P2J-3's region recomputed through P2J-4's machinery; legacy RR never read (LegacyLock), the P2F region never consumed (P2FGuard); no RR range, candidate or approval; the HR / baroreflex uncertainty is carried, not multiplied, since it does not reach RR.
design.probe_rule: Synthetic, structural only (no gain read from them), on the neutral arrival (RR0 16, demand met, FiO2 0.21) with its lactate at 2.5 (above the 2.0 drive threshold, so a change is read), at the default RR parameters with reserve 2.5. A: an acid load with normal delivery is not representable. B: the RR the core derives at lactate 6 with no deficit, no D and W 0, against arrival. C: the pump cut to 0.3 for 20 minutes (an effective deficit, D accruing) with the default lactate production and with production 0 (lactate held), so any RR response is attributed to its path. D: pCO2 is not representable; W -0.5 (the only 'inadequate ventilation' the core can write) is read. E: an effective-ventilation output separate from RR does not exist; W +0.5 is read. Hypoxaemia: arrival SpO2 85 against 97. Oxygen: FiO2 0.6 from minute 1. Clearance: the same steady D with tau_lactate 30 and 120 min.
design.reconstruction_rule: RR is a pure function of W, the authored arrival RR and lactate, the RR parameters and the derived lactate (respiratory_rate). The certified physiology's lactate is P2J-3's: its primary region recomputed (baroreflex.pressure_tone_region), each survivor's blood trajectory rebuilt at its tone gain (vascular_tone.rebuild) and its D and lactate read by the lactate machinery (vascular_tone.debt_and_lactate), both exact against the core. RR is then derived with W = 0 and the default RR parameters, with no parameter changed; one full core run per scenario, case, demand and tone gain checks it. HR, MAP_set and the baroreflex gain do not reach RR, so they are not multiplied in.

support.FiO2: a setting; read by SpO2 only

support.supplemental oxygen: Oxygen writes the FiO2 setting; SpO2 = arrival SpO2 + 30 x (FiO2 - arrival FiO2 above room air); W, RR, D and lactate unchanged by it

design.verdict_rule: READY when: the RR contributors are explicit; W is a COHERENT_EFFECTIVE_VENTILATION_STATE; no lactate path is a BIOMARKER_PROXY; metabolic acidosis -> drive is representable without lactate; ventilation and frequency are separate; respiratory-support overrides are coherent; the directional probes pass (none violated or not representable); the candidate surface is explicit; nothing is approved. Otherwise NOT_READY with the first blocker in BLOCKERS order.

w_audit.why: defined as ventilation relative to need, read as a drive / load: a bronchospasm load (less effective ventilation) is written as W > 0 and raises RR, a depressed drive (less ventilation) as W < 0 and lowers it; no output reports effective ventilation, and RR is the only ventilatory observable
w_audit.writers: no GI or core module; only the synthetic calibration probes (bands 'bronchospasm' W +0.5 as work, 'opioid' W -0.7 as drive)
